auth.no_access: Your account is not in any of Ledger's groups. Ask an administrator for access.
logged_out.title: You are logged out
budget.title: Budget %d
budget.none: There is no budget for %d yet.
budget.copy_hint: Starts with the same lines as %d. Amounts are only copied when ticked.
budget.empty_hint: Starts from scratch with no lines.
budget.link: Take the amounts from a line in another budget
budget.linked_from: Linked from %s › %s › %s; change the amounts there
budget.link_broken: Link broken: %s › %s › %s is not in this year; the last amounts are kept
budget.link_hint: The amounts come from that line in the same year and can only be changed there. Copying a year keeps the link.
budget.link_none: No other budget you can see has lines in %d.
budget.conflicts: Some changes were not saved, because the same fields were changed elsewhere in the meantime:
budget.conflict_amount: %s, %s: you entered %s, but it was saved as %s.
budget.conflict_name: "%s" was renamed to "%s"; your name "%s" was not saved.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.arrows: Move between cells; while editing, ← → move within the text
help.line: Start / end of the line (first / last month)
help.gG: First / last line of the budget, also from outside the table
help.braces: Previous / next section, also from outside the table
help.ia: Edit with the cursor at the start / end (a click in a name does the same); h l ← → then move within the text
help.esc: Stop editing; press again to leave the field
help.f: Copy the amount to the following months (an empty cell clears them)
help.yp: Copy the value / paste it into the current cell
help.K: Show the previous values of the field
help.note: A selected field takes the keys above as commands; type in a name after i, a or a click.
settings.title: Settings
settings.start_budget_hint: Opened from the menu and on the statistics page.
settings.stats_years_hint: The newest years shown until you choose a range on the page.
settings.stats_changes: Statistics tables show changes by default
settings.stats_month_changes: A line's statistics show the change for each month by default
settings.stats_changes_hint: Each table can still be switched on and off on the page.
manage.no_links: No line takes its amounts from another budget.
manage.everyone_label: Everyone who can log in can see it
manage.access_hint: The owner, the members and members of the groups (comma-separated group names from the identity provider) can see the budget, and admins see all budgets. What they can do in it follows their role.
manage.default_hint: The default budget is at /budget/<year> and cannot be deleted.
manage.delete_budget_hint: Deleting a budget removes all its years, lines, amounts and history. Type its name to confirm.
manage.default_kept: The default budget cannot be deleted.
manage.create_hint: A new budget is private: only you see it until you add members, groups or everyone.
manage.budget_invalid: A budget needs a name, and its address may only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes, and not only digits.
manage.slug_taken: The address %s is already used by another budget.
manage.delete_hint: Deleting a year removes its lines, amounts and history. Type the year in its field to confirm.
manage.name: Name
manage.restore_hint: Restore sets the field back to its value before the change.
manage.keep_hint: When a field changes again, its oldest changes beyond this number are removed. 0 keeps no history.
settings.lang_hint: To add a language, copy locales/en.json to a new file such as de.json in LEDGER_LOCALES_DIR, translate it and restart.
bank.no_accounts: No bank accounts yet. Add one to import its transactions.
bank.delete_account_confirm: Delete the account %s and its %d transactions?
bank.import_hint: The file is read first and shown, so you can check it before anything is imported. Rows imported before are skipped.
bank.imported: Imported %d new transactions; %s were imported before.
bank.undo_confirm: Undo this import and delete its %d transactions?
bank.err_csv: The file could not be read as CSV.
bank.err_columns: Too few columns for this bank format.
bank.err_date: Not a date in this bank format:
bank.err_amount: Not an amount in this bank format:
bank.delete_transaction_confirm: Delete %s (%s)? It comes back if a file with it is imported again.
manage.plugins_hint: A plugin that is off is hidden from the menu and its pages, for everyone. Its data is kept.
plugin.bank.about: Bank accounts per budget, with transactions imported from the bank's CSV export and assigned to budget lines by rules.
bank.unassigned_count: %d transactions in %d are not assigned to a budget line.
bank.no_budget_year: The budget has no year %d, so its transactions cannot be assigned to lines yet.
bank.remember_hint: Make a rule from the text, so transactions like it are assigned the same way
bank.by_rule_hint: Assigned by a rule. Changing it here assigns it by hand.
bank.assign_hint: Ignored transactions are not counted in the budget, e.g. transfers between your own accounts. With Remember ticked, a rule is made from the text without dates and used for the transactions not yet assigned.
bank.rules_hint: A rule assigns every transaction whose text contains the rule's text, in any case. When several rules fit, the most specific wins. Rules only assign transactions that are not assigned; those assigned by hand are left alone.
bank.rule_new: New rule, e.g. a loan number
bank.rule_delete_confirm: Delete the rule %s? The %d transactions it assigned become unassigned.
bank.no_rules: No rules yet. They are made when you assign transactions with Remember ticked, or here.
bank.rule_err_duplicate: Two rules cannot have the same text.
bank.rule_err_target: Choose a budget line for the new rule.
bank.rule_err_empty: A rule needs some text besides *.
bank.rules_tip_contains: The rule's text only has to be part of the transaction's text, in any case: pharmacy matches "Pharmacy Main Street 12" and "PHARMACY STATION".
bank.rules_tip_star: * stands for any text: pharmacy*street matches "Pharmacy Main Street 12" and "Pharmacy High Street", but not "Pharmacy Station".
bank.rules_tip_keep: Keep only the part that stays the same: pharmacy instead of "Card purchase Pharmacy Main Street 12".
bank.compare_no_year: The budget has no years yet.
bank.compare_unassigned: %d transactions in the period, %s in all, are not assigned to a line and not counted.
bank.compare_hint: Actual is the sum of the transactions assigned to the line in the period; ignored ones are left out. The difference is green where the line did better than budgeted: less spent, or more earned.
bank.compared_none: No months to compare: no transactions are imported for this year.
bank.fill: Fill the budget from the bank…
bank.fill_kept: %d amounts set by hand are kept. Choose Overwrite amounts to replace them too.
bank.fill_hint: Each amount is saved like an edit on the budget page, with history, so it can be restored under Manage.
bank.fill_nothing: Nothing to fill: the budget already has these amounts.
bank.fill_untouched: Lines without transactions in a month, and linked lines, are not changed.
